en: Old sepia photograph mounted in a decorated card frame showing a cluster of modest, weathered houses with tiled roofs and wooden sheds or fences in a dense urban neighborhood. The architecture appears Balkan/Ottoman-influenced, with upper stories slightly overhanging and clay roof tiles. The mount has floral ornaments and handwritten text in a Cyrillic script at the top and bottom.
